# Options

<!-- Generated by `nix run .#update-docs` from the option declarations. Do not edit by hand. -->

## company\.asOf

Reference date (ISO 8601, ` YYYY-MM-DD `) for date-relative checks\.
Evaluation is pure and cannot read the clock, so checks that need
“today” use this value when set\. Leave null to skip them\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"2026-11-16"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/meta\.nix](https://github.com/Qezta/company-framework/blob/main/modules/meta.nix)
